verdict.rationale: Unleash has a public GitHub repository (Unleash/unleash), and its docs name a self-hostable "Unleash Open Source" edition alongside Enterprise. A community commenter also refers to it as an open-source solution, so the core story of reading the source is met. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named (e.g., Apache-2.0), and it is not documented which Enterprise features (RBAC, change requests, SSO, Edge) sit outside the open-source code.
